plan: Since this is a one-round auction and my value is $7, I should bid slightly above my value to maximize potential profit while minimizing loss. Given the rationality of bidders, they would not bid above their value. Thus, I will bid $7.1 to potentially win if others bid below or at their value. This ensures that if I win, I pay a minimal amount close to my value, maximizing my profit.

Given my value of $16, I aim to maximize my profit by bidding slightly below my value, accounting for rational behavior. Bidders will likely bid close to their value, knowing they pay the third-highest bid. I will bid $15.9 to potentially win if others bid lower, while minimizing loss if I win. This bid is close to my value, maximizing my profit if I win, yet strategically low enough to avoid overpaying.

Given my value of $21, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit if I win. Rational bidders will bid close to or slightly below their own values. To avoid overbidding, I will bid $20.9, slightly below my value, to ensure a potential win while minimizing the risk of paying too much. This bid is competitive against other rational bidders who will likely bid near their values, which are independently drawn.
